places.name: City Palace
places.description: No single structure better captures the grandeur and artistic legacy of the Mewar dynasty.

places.name: Lake Pichola
places.description: The boat ride at dusk, with palaces and ghats lit by the setting sun, is simply unforgettable.
places.bestTime: Sunset boat ride, October to March

places.name: Lake Palace (Taj Lake Palace)
places.description: Dining in a floating 18th-century palace on a Rajasthani lake is a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

places.name: Jag Mandir Island Palace
places.description: The island garden café and architecture provide a peaceful escape from the mainland.

places.name: Sajjangarh Palace (Monsoon Palace)
places.description: The 360-degree sunset panorama of Udaipur's lakes and rooftops is spectacular.

places.name: Fateh Sagar Lake
places.description: The lake promenade at dusk, with the hills reflected in calm water, is quintessentially Udaipur.

places.name: Jagdish Temple
places.description: Evening aarti here, with chanting and incense smoke rising against carved stone, is deeply atmospheric.

places.name: Saheliyon Ki Bari (Garden of the Maidens)
places.description: A rare, beautifully preserved example of royal Mewar garden design and water engineering.

places.name: Bagore Ki Haveli
places.description: The evening cultural show is the best place in Udaipur to experience traditional Rajasthani folk arts.

places.name: Gangaur Ghat
places.description: This ghat at sunrise, with mist on the lake and early bathers, offers the most atmospheric photography in Udaipur.

budget.label: Budget
budget.blurb: Hostels or guesthouses, local food, public transport

midRange.label: Mid-range
midRange.blurb: Three-star hotels, a mix of restaurants, the odd taxi

comfortable.label: Comfortable
comfortable.blurb: Good four-star stays, restaurants by choice, tours
